description: Create a new standalone Pine v5 file smc_fvg.pine (title 'SMC - FVG | Emmanuel') that extracts ONLY the market-structure engine (internal + swing BOS/CHoCH detection, structure lines/labels, trend color-candles) and the 'FVG within BOS/CHoCH' feature from ict.pine, PLUS one new input: an Internal/Swing/Both selector that gates which structure breaks trigger the FVG-in-structure highlight. Do NOT modify ict.pine. This is a self-contained single-file extraction; there are no dependent features.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/tradingviewbridge/smc_fvg.pine. First line: '//@version=5'. Second line: indicator('SMC - FVG | Emmanuel', 'SMC - FVG', overlay = true, max_labels_count = 500, max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500).

Copy ONLY the constants that the kept code references, from ict.pine lines 6-30: BULLISH_LEG=1, BEARISH_LEG=0, BULLISH=+1, BEARISH=-1, GREEN, RED, MONO_BULLISH, MONO_BEARISH, HISTORICAL, PRESENT, COLORED, MONOCHROME, ALL, BOS, CHOCH, TINY=size.tiny, SMALL=size.small, NORMAL=size.normal. Also define the group-name string constants used by the kept inputs: SMART_GROUP='Smart Money Concepts', INTERNAL_GROUP='Real Time Internal Structure', SWING_GROUP='Real Time Swing Structure', STRUCT_FVG_GROUP='FVG in BOS/CHoCH'. Do NOT copy constants only used by excluded features (BLUE, GRAY, ATR, RANGE, CLOSE, HIGHLOW, FVG_OFF/FVG_ONLY/BPR_ONLY/FVG_BOTH, SOLID/DASHED/DOTTED, EQUAL_GROUP, GAPS_GROUP*, LEVELS_GROUP, ZONES_GROUP, SESSIONS_GROUP, BLOCKS_GROUP) unless a kept line references them.

Copy the STRUCTURE input group from ict.pine lines 80-98: modeInput(@80), styleInput(@81), showTrendInput(@82); showInternalsInput(@84), showInternalBullInput(@85), internalBullColorInput(@86), showInternalBearInput(@87), internalBearColorInput(@88), internalFilterConfluenceInput(@89), internalStructureSize(@90); showStructureInput(@92), showSwingBullInput(@93), swingBullColorInput(@94), showSwingBearInput(@95), swingBearColorInput(@96), swingStructureSize(@97), showSwingsInput(@98). Also copy swingsLengthInput(@99) and showHighLowSwingsInput(@100). Copy their tooltip string definitions too (modeTooltip, styleTooltip, showTrendTooltip, showInternalsTooltip, internalFilterConfluenceTooltip, showStructureTooltip, showSwingsTooltip) from ict.pine lines ~59-67. Do NOT copy order-block, EQH/EQL, FVG-engine, MTF, sessions, premium/discount inputs.

Copy the FVG-in-structure input group from ict.pine lines 146-150: showStructFvgInput, structFvgBullColorInput, structFvgBearColorInput, structFvgDeleteInput (keep them under STRUCT_FVG_GROUP with identical defaults/tooltips).

ADD the NEW selector input directly after the structFvg inputs: define string constants STRUCT_FVG_INTERNAL='Internal', STRUCT_FVG_SWING='Swing', STRUCT_FVG_BOTH='Both' and input structFvgSourceInput = input.string(STRUCT_FVG_INTERNAL, 'Apply to', group = STRUCT_FVG_GROUP, options = [STRUCT_FVG_INTERNAL, STRUCT_FVG_SWING, STRUCT_FVG_BOTH], tooltip = 'Which structure breaks highlight the FVG within the BOS/CHoCH: Internal only, Swing only, or Both.').

Copy ONLY the required types from ict.pine: `pivot` (@322-329), `trend` (@306-307), and `structFvg` (@297-303). Copy `alerts` (@202-218) but KEEP ONLY the structure bool fields: internalBullishBOS, internalBearishBOS, internalBullishCHoCH, internalBearishCHoCH, swingBullishBOS, swingBearishBOS, swingBullishCHoCH, swingBearishCHoCH. DROP the orderBlock/equalHighs/equalLows/fairValueGap fields. Do NOT copy trailingExtremes, fairValueGap, bpr, sessionState, sessionLevel, equalDisplay, orderBlock types (all excluded).

Copy ONLY the required var/state declarations from ict.pine lines ~340-410: var pivot swingHigh, swingLow, internalHigh, internalLow (each = pivot.new(na,na,false)); var trend swingTrend = trend.new(0); var trend internalTrend = trend.new(0); var array<structFvg> structFvgs = array.new<structFvg>(); var swingBullishColor = styleInput == MONOCHROME ? MONO_BULLISH : swingBullColorInput; var swingBearishColor = styleInput == MONOCHROME ? MONO_BEARISH : swingBearColorInput; alerts currentAlerts = alerts.new(). Do NOT copy equalHigh/equalLow pivots, equalHighDisplay/equalLowDisplay, fairValueGaps arrays, bprs arrays, sessionLevels, parsedHighs/parsedLows/highs/lows/times arrays, trailing extremes, order block arrays/boxes, fvg colors, premium/discount colors, currentBarIndex/lastBarIndex, initialTime, the barstate.isfirst order-block box creation block, atrMeasure/volatilityMeasure/parsedHigh/parsedLow, order-block mitigation sources.

Copy the functions in this DEFINITION-BEFORE-USE order: (1) leg(int size) @453; (2) startOfNewLeg @467, startOfBearishLeg @472, startOfBullishLeg @477; (3) drawLabel @487 (needed by getCurrentStructure's showSwingsInput branch); (4) getCurrentStructure @525 - but STRIP its equalHighLow branches: remove the `if equalHighLow and math.abs(...) < equalHighsLowsThresholdInput * atrMeasure` blocks and their drawEqualHighLow/currentAlerts.equalLows/equalHighs calls; keep the equalHighLow param for signature compatibility OR remove it and its call site (simpler: keep signature `getCurrentStructure(int size, bool equalHighLow = false, bool internal = false)` and just delete the equalHighLow-guarded inner blocks). Also STRIP the `trailing.*` writes (trailing.bottom/top/barTime/barIndex/lastBottomTime/lastTopTime) since trailingExtremes is excluded - remove the two `if not equalHighLow and not internal` trailing-write blocks entirely. Keep the drawLabel calls guarded by showSwingsInput.

Continue functions: (5) drawStructure @583; (6) highlightStructFvg @673 (copy verbatim - it already ends in trailing `true` and guards with `if span >= 2`); (7) maintainStructFvgs @695 (copy verbatim - ends in trailing `true`); (8) displayStructure @712. In displayStructure: REMOVE the storeOrdeBlock calls (both the bullish `if (internal and showInternalOrderBlocksInput)... storeOrdeBlock(...)` and bearish equivalents). CHANGE the FVG highlight gating: replace the bullish-side `if internal\n    highlightStructFvg(p_ivot.barIndex, true)` with a gate that fires for internal breaks when structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_INTERNAL or STRUCT_FVG_BOTH, and for swing breaks when structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_SWING or STRUCT_FVG_BOTH. Concretely: bullMakeFvg = showStructFvgInput and ((internal and (structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_INTERNAL or structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_BOTH)) or (not internal and (structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_SWING or structFvgSourceInput == STRUCT_FVG_BOTH))); then `if bullMakeFvg\n    highlightStructFvg(p_ivot.barIndex, true)`. Apply the same gate on the bearish side with `highlightStructFvg(p_ivot.barIndex, false)`. Keep drawStructure display-condition logic intact.

Copy the trend color-candles block from ict.pine lines 1157-1159: parsedOpen = showTrendInput ? open : na; candleColor = internalTrend.bias == BULLISH ? swingBullishColor : swingBearishColor; plotcandle(parsedOpen,high,low,close,color=candleColor,wickcolor=candleColor,bordercolor=candleColor).

Copy the EXECUTION block (guarded calls) from ict.pine lines ~1193-1207, keeping ONLY: `if showStructFvgInput` -> maintainStructFvgs(); getCurrentStructure(swingsLengthInput,false); getCurrentStructure(5,false,true); `if showInternalsInput or showTrendInput or showStructFvgInput` -> displayStructure(true); `if showStructureInput or showHighLowSwingsInput` -> displayStructure(). REMOVE order-block guards (showInternalOrderBlocksInput/showSwingOrderBlocksInput), deleteOrderBlocks, drawOrderBlocks, FVG-engine draws, session/MTF/premium-discount, and the equalHighLow getCurrentStructure call.

Copy the ALERTS block but KEEP ONLY the 8 structure alertconditions from ict.pine lines ~1244-1251 (internalBullishBOS, internalBullishCHoCH, internalBearishBOS, internalBearishCHoCH, swingBullishBOS/'Bullish BOS', swingBullishCHoCH/'Bullish CHoCH', swingBearishBOS/'Bearish BOS', swingBearishCHoCH/'Bearish CHoCH'). Drop order-block, equal, and FVG alertconditions.

Do a full static self-review pass over smc_fvg.pine: confirm (a) every called function is defined earlier in the file; (b) every void function ends in trailing `true` (highlightStructFvg, maintainStructFvgs); (c) no reference remains to any stripped symbol; (d) no break/continue; (e) loops are size-guarded. Fix any dangling references introduced by stripping.
acceptance_criteria: File /projects/sandbox/tradingviewbridge/smc_fvg.pine exists, starts with '//@version=5', and the indicator() title is exactly 'SMC - FVG | Emmanuel'.

grep of smc_fvg.pine finds NONE of these excluded symbols: orderBlock, storeOrdeBlock, deleteOrderBlocks, drawOrderBlocks, drawEqualHighLow, equalHighsLowsThresholdInput, fairValueGap, maintainFairValueGaps, bpr, sessionState, sessionLevel, drawLevels, premiumZone, dashboard, trailing.
grep confirms the FVG highlight is gated by structFvgSourceInput and that highlightStructFvg is called on BOTH internal and swing break paths in displayStructure (not only internal).
The new input structFvgSourceInput with options Internal/Swing/Both exists under STRUCT_FVG_GROUP.

Every function called in the file is defined above its first call site (leg/startOfNewLeg/startOfBullishLeg/startOfBearishLeg before getCurrentStructure; highlightStructFvg and maintainStructFvgs before displayStructure).
highlightStructFvg and maintainStructFvgs each end with a trailing `true`.
ict.pine and all other existing files are unchanged (git shows only smc_fvg.pine and .agents/ as new).
verification: Run: grep -nE 'orderBlock|storeOrdeBlock|deleteOrderBlocks|drawOrderBlocks|drawEqualHighLow|fairValueGap|maintainFairValueGaps|\bbpr\b|sessionState|sessionLevel|drawLevels|premiumZone|trailing' smc_fvg.pine  -> expect no matches.
Run: grep -n 'structFvgSourceInput' smc_fvg.pine -> expect the input definition plus its use in the bullish and bearish gates inside displayStructure.
Run: grep -n 'highlightStructFvg' smc_fvg.pine -> expect the definition plus two call sites (bull + bear paths).
Run: grep -n "indicator('SMC - FVG | Emmanuel'" smc_fvg.pine -> expect one match.
Static self-review: read the whole file top-to-bottom and confirm definition-before-use ordering and trailing-true on void functions.
Run: git status --porcelain -> expect only smc_fvg.pine and .agents/ paths as changes; ict.pine NOT listed.

findings: Created smc_fvg.pine (self-contained, 356 lines) on branch feat/smc-fvg-extract. INCLUDED: market-structure engine (leg/startOfNewLeg/startOfBearishLeg/startOfBullishLeg, drawLabel, getCurrentStructure, drawStructure, displayStructure), internal+swing BOS/CHoCH detection, structure lines/labels, trend color-candles (plotcandle), and the FVG-in-BOS/CHoCH feature (structFvg type, structFvgs array, highlightStructFvg, maintainStructFvgs, its inputs). User must paste into TradingView to confirm compilation. REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-11-185458-review.md, NEEDS_CHANGES): Issue 1 (stranded showHighLowSwingsInput) FIXED - removed the showHighLowSwingsInput input definition and its now-unused showHighLowSwingsTooltip constant, and reduced the swing execution guard from 'if showStructureInput or showHighLowSwingsInput' to 'if showStructureInput'. This removes the behavioral divergence where swing structure drew even with showStructureInput off, and removes the misleading 'Show Strong/Weak High/Low' UI label naming a stripped feature. Verified: grep 'showHighLowSwings' returns zero matches; swing guard is now 'if showStructureInput'.
